theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_tangential_matrix_estimates
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (b : ℝ), 1 ≤ b → ‖L‖ ≤ b → (∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ b * ‖L v‖) → (∀ i j : Fin N, |inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))| ≤ b ^ 2 + 1) ∧ ∀ ξ : Fin N → ℝ, (b ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ξ i * (inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) * ξ j
